name: Justin Manduke
headline: VP of Professional Services @ Optro | ex-Medallia, Blend, Afresh
about:
I am an experienced post-sales SaaS leader, passionate about building multidisciplinary teams that deliver great customer experiences using innovative software solutions. It has been a privilege to creatively drive exceptional results in some of the most celebrated enterprise technology companies: Medallia (IPO in 2019), Blend (IPO in 2021), Afresh, and now AuditBoard (acquired in 2024), where I lead the Professional Services team globally. Balancing operational rigor and client advocacy, I have led and grown customer teams across Professional Services, Implementations, Technical Support, and Customer Success at early-stage private firms through public, global scale.

experiences.description: I lead Professional Services globally for the leading GRC system of action, including Implementations, Technical Account Management, Partner Services, Customer Training, and Services GTM Strategy.

experiences.position: Vice President, Customer Operations and Delivery
experiences.description: Member of Afresh’s executive leadership team overseeing all post-sale customer teams, including Deployments, Technical Support, and Engagement Management. Partnered closely with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Strategy leads to drive successful customer outcomes and bring maturity and scale to company go-to-market operations. Owned and implemented board-level objectives including management to fundraising targets, cash runway planning, strategic product alignment to market trends, organization design, and management recruiting.

Led the Delivery organization for Blend globally, responsible for predictable, fast, and effective platform implementations for Blend's customers. Spearheaded collaboration between Professional Services and the Engineering, Product, Sales, Support, and Enablement teams through high-paced growth and product launches.

--More than doubled Professional Services billings in first year leading the team
--Doubled team size in one year to 50+ implementation resources in a remote environment
--Increased professional services billing rate by 81%
--Redesigned the team's operational systems and standards for success through IPO

Directly responsible for delivery, SaaS/services revenue recognition, expansions, renewal, and solution design for a large portfolio of Fortune 500 clients. Team of direct reports included Senior Managers, Managers, and Analysts in Professional Services who manage client relationships and outcomes. Quarterly public company activities included exceeding revenue targets communicated to Wall Street through a combination of professional services delivery as well as software expansions using Medallia’s core technologies and frequent application acquisitions.
